name: Drake, Lava
body:
Lava Drake CR 10

XP 9,600
CE Large dragon (fire)
Init +6; Senses dragon senses; Perception +18

DEFENSE

AC 23, touch 11, flat-footed 21 (+2 Dex, +12 natural, –1 size)
hp 130 (10d12+65)
Fort +10, Ref +9, Will +7
DR 5/magic; Immune fire, paralysis, sleep; SR 16

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft., fly 120 ft. (average)
Melee bite +16 (2d6+6), , 2 claws +16 (1d8+6)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft.
Special Attacks breath weapon (80-ft. line, DC 22, 8d6 fire)

STATISTICS

Str 22; Dex 15; Con 16; Int 14; Wis 14; Cha 15
Base Atk +10; CMB +18; CMD 36
Feats Combat Reflexes, Improved Initiative, Improved Natural Armor, Iron Will
Skills Fly +18, Intimidate +15, Knowledge (arcana) +12, Perception +18, Sense Motive +18, Stealth +16
Languages Common, Draconic, Giant

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Spell-Like Abilities (Sp)

At will, pyrotechnics

Breath Weapon (Sp)

The lava breath weapon remains behind for two rounds after being used. Any creature in contact with the lava takes 6d6 points of fire damage on the first round, 4d6 on the second, and none thereafter as the lava hardens and cools.

ECOLOGY

Environment warm or hot mountains
Organization solitary
Treasure triple

Lava drakes are smaller dragonets, more closely related to wyverns and linnorms than true dragons. These drakes are malicious and fierce, and will spend hours playing with their prey. Lava drakes are beholden to red dragons, and will usually follow commands gives by an adult or older red dragon.

The lava drake’s breath weapon is a line of molten lava. Lava drakes will use their breath weapon to close off escape routes and slowly torture their foes before finishing them off. Their craving for treasure nearly matches that of their red dragon kin.

Lava drakes are 25 feet long and weigh 2,800 pounds at maturity. They have bright red, scaled hides and are hot to the touch.
